posts.author: CleanWater
posts.body: I'm publishing my game on Steam and got a message that Steam Overlay is not enabled. How do I implement that in RPG Maker MV?

posts.author: SGHarlekin
posts.body:
IIRC on your steamworks page, navigate to this:
put --in-process-gpu in the arguments. It's been years since I did this, but it should be it. (I wasn't able to find language settings on the page, so you'll have to make do with this.)

posts.author: CleanWater
posts.body: Only this? I don't need to add any custom plugin to the game or something like that?

posts.author: ElvenNeko
posts.body: Yes, i can confirm since i enabled it the same way. You should be able to test it yoruself in a minute. Don't forget to enable overlay in steam settings for yourself (if it's off).

posts.author: CleanWater
posts.body: And it works for Linux and MacOS as well?

posts.author: ATT_Turan
posts.body:
CleanWater said:
And it works for Linux and MacOS as well?
Click to expand...
MV games themselves don't work on modern MacOS.
There might be someone here who has deployed MV games on Steam for all of these operating systems, and checked with enabling the overlay, but these seem like questions you might answer more quickly by looking in the Steam documentation.

posts.author: bgillisp
posts.body:
To add to this, MV support was officially discontinued for Mac ages ago. If you can get it still running on Mac you have an older system most likely.
If you really want to release for Mac you need to move to MZ.
